svg.title: Rideshare Rails API with PostgreSQL physical replication
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing the Rideshare Rails 7 API using Multiple Databases with rideshare and rideshare_replica config names from database-multiple.sample.yml, connecting to a primary PostgreSQL 18 instance for reads and writes, and a physical streaming replica for read-only queries.
